_doc: clinic-voice-unavailable — 'Talk to Cedarfield' degrades honestly, BEFORE the button (2026-09-02).
On a deployment without the server keys (every local eval run) the panel probes GET /api/voice/session
on mount, says 'Voice is not set up on this deployment' and disables the button — a reviewer never
discovers it by pressing (Codex audit). The page is otherwise unchanged and the tools still register.
The live path (secret → WebRTC → tools over the data channel) is evals/manual/clinic-voice-live.json.

matches: Voice is not set up on this deployment

_doc: The route itself refuses a request that is not from the page (no Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin) — proven by the same fetch a script would make.

eval: (() => { window.__vs = 0; fetch('/api/voice/session', { method: 'POST' }).then(r => { window.__vs = r.status; }); return true; })()
